Sam (PM): Heads-up — quick sync on billing shape + token accounting for per-route behavior before we lock the spec for the roadmap review tomorrow. Need alignment on cost signals for chat vs embeddings vs rerank.
Lee (Eng): I can join. Proposal: keep token-based billing as the canonical unit, but expose an optional `route_multiplier` that maps to per-route billing weights.
Maria (Finance): Strong +1 to single canonical unit. If we introduce multilples we need clear conversion table and rounding rules for invoicing.
Jules (ML): Also: function/tool-calls blow up token usage unpredictably. We should consider a separate "tooling" surcharge or capped estimation model.
Priya (Legal): Any surcharge needs to be documented in T&Cs and clearly surfaced during onboarding. Also mention refunds/credits on misbilling.
Lee (Eng): Drafted a sample shape for API metadata — thinking `route_tags` + `pricing_class` fields so gateways can pick accounting:

```
{
  "route_tags": ["chat","support"],
  "pricing_class": "standard", // standard | premium | embeddings
  "estimated_tokens": 245
}
```

Sam (PM): That looks good. Two decisions: 1) whether rerank is billed per-candidate vs per-token, 2) whether embeddings are per-vector or per-token for large models.
Maria (Finance): For rerank we prefer per-candidate for predictability, but tie a token floor for very long docs. For embeddings, per-vector is simpler for customers; we can convert tokens->vectors for legacy usage but must show equivalence on billing statements.
Jules (ML): Technically per-vector maps cleanly when vectors are fixed size. For models that output variable-length vectors (rare) we fallback to token-equivalent pricing.
Lee (Eng): Implementation note: runtime needs to attach `billing_keys` to the request early so we can route to correct metering pipeline. Will add to the SDKs.
Sam (PM): Launch criteria draft: (a) API surface stable (route_tags + pricing_class), (b) billing conversion table published, (c) invoices show line-item tokens + adjusted billing amount, (d) smoke tests for extreme tool-run costs.
Priya (Legal): Also include opt-in consent for customers that want explicit per-request pre-authorization on spikes.
Maria (Finance): We'll need a migration path for existing customers — backfill a 3-month equivalence report and allow dispute window of 60 days on first invoice after rollout.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: billing-metering-v2 -> canary at 2026-05-12T03:00Z
Lee (Eng): I'll add a small SDK flag `billing: { mode: "per_vector" | "per_token" }` for experiments. Will push a design doc to eng-platform.
Sam (PM): Great. Action items: Lee to PR SDK fields + runtime tags; Maria to draft conversion table and invoice examples; Priya to tweak terms; Jules to write cost-estimates for tool-calls. Sync at 11:00am tomorrow.
Maria (Finance): I'll prepare a short spreadsheet with examples (chat 512 tokens, embedding 1024 tokens -> x vectors) and cost deltas.
Jules (ML): I'll include sample worst-case tool-call traces.
Sam (PM): Thanks all. If anyone wants to add edge cases (e.g., multi-model pipelines, chained tools) put them here before EOD.
